name: Emilia Sykes
summary:
Emilia Strong Sykes (born January 4, 1986) is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for Ohio's 13th congressional district since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, she represented the 34th district of the Ohio House of Representatives, centered on Akron, from 2015 to 2022, and served as minority leader of that chamber from 2019 to 2021.
Sykes was first elected to Congress in 2022 and narrowly won reelection in 2024 in one of the country's most competitive House races.
